# Hardik Mittal

> Associate Product Manager at TMRW House of Brands (Aditya Birla Fashion's house of D2C fashion brands: Bewakoof, Nobero, TIGC, Wrogn), based in Bengaluru, India. A product manager who also writes the code: GenAI content platforms, personalization, experimentation and analytics systems, plus side projects. Open to product management and forward-deployed engineering conversations.

## Key facts

- Current role: Associate Product Manager, TMRW House of Brands, Nov 2025 to present (promoted from Product Management Intern, Jul 2024 to Oct 2025); works directly with brand and merchandising teams, building their tools and improving storefronts from their feedback
- Education: B.E. (Hons.) Computer Science, Minor in Finance, BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus, 2021 to 2025; Disha Delphi Public School, Kota, 2017 to 2021 (IIT-JEE 2021 AIR 8819, top 0.5 percentile; BITSAT 319/450; Class XII CBSE 92.8%)
- Headline results: GoKwik Checkout, +10.5% session conversion on Bewakoof.com; Dynamic Homepage, +13.8% tap rate and +5.4% homepage-to-order conversion in a live test; Urbano product-page work, +6.5% AOV; WhyBuy AI content live on 2,000+ products across six brands; ABF T-Shirt Studio shipped in three weeks with 500+ orders and 1,000+ concurrent users; 30+ A/B tests across four brand stores on GrowthBook
- Core stack: TypeScript, Python, SQL, Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL/pgvector, BigQuery, ClickHouse, AWS, GCP, Gemini, Claude, GPT-Image, MCP, RAG
